draft_en.subject: A budget industrial media-converter position below the branded lines
draft_en.body:
Hello Abigo4u team,

Last year you had a product mail from us - "Industrial PoE Switch" on 16 February 2025 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

Alongside the media-converter brands you carry, three neutral-brand industrial converters, DIN-rail, -40 to 75 C, CE/RoHS, from single units: Gigabit, 1 x RJ45 + 1 x SFP slot - model STI-110GE - $26.5 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); Gigabit PoE+ (powers the camera or AP on the copper side) - STI-111GP - $27.8; Fast Ethernet - STI-110FE - $19.7. SFP optics we do not supply.

One question: is there a budget MC position your customers ask for below the branded lines - and which type, gigabit or PoE?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
